discovery_notes: DLR 2016 LE/LR leads from search snippets only (29 standard WebSearch calls, blocked domains excluded). Mostly Disney Pins Blog event posts and weekly roundups; Disney Pin Forum and one Flickr collector post used for Date Nite members, HMH puzzle shape and Royalty mystery set. Shared DL+WDW releases included where snippets name Disneyland. Resellers (ecrater, collectrandom, wdwpinpals, worthpoint, yourwdwstore, whatnot) ignored. No sets split by character without a source naming the pin; Date Nite couples come from a forum ISO list.
